To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the solution-processed (NH4)PbIx perovskite film can be used as a hole transport layer in the CuInS2-based perovskite heterojunction solar cell, which is prepared at low temperature.

the ITO/CIS/Al2O3/perovskite/Ag planar heterojuction solar cells were successfully prepared by solution process and low temperature, which showed a power conversion efficiency of 5.3% and a high stability.
the low-temperature solution processed CH3NH3 PbI3 perov-skite/CuIn S2 planar hetero junction solar cells with Al 2O3 as scaffold were fabricated for the first time.

the low-temperature fabrication of high-performance perovskite/Chalcopyrite heterojunction solar cell.
the fabrication of efficient perovskite/semiconductor heterojunctions at low temperatures.
the development of low-temperature processed CH3NH3 PbI3 perovskytes/CuInS 2 planar hetero-junction solar cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the low-temperature solution processed CH3NH3 PbI3/CuInS planar heterojuntion solar cells are fabricated for the first time.
the solution-processed perovskite/semiconductor planar heterojuction solar cell has great potential to be developed into an efficient and low-temperature solution-processing photovoltaic device.
the ITO/CIS(n)/Al2OX/(CH3NH4)PbI2/Ag planar heterojuction solar cell with low temperature process is a promising candidate for low-cost and flexible perovskite photovoltaic device.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed an efficient and low-cost perovskite planar heterojuctin solar cell by replacing the commonly used Ti-based oxide layer with the solution-processed metal sulfide layer.

the low-temperature processed CH3NH3I-based perovskite layer and CuInS2 absorber layer can be used to prepare the perovskite/sulfide planar heterojuntion solar cells, and the ITO/Copper indium disulphide (CuInSe2)/Al2o3/(CH3 NH3)Pb I3/Ag cell with a power conversion efficiency up 5.3% is obtained.

we have successfully developed a low-temperature solution-based fabrication method for the fabrication of perovskite/semiconductor planar heterojuction solar cells, which may open up new avenues for the fabrication of high-efficiency perovskite based solar cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the ITO/Copper Indium Disulfide (CuIndS2)/Al2 O3/(CH3 NH3)Pb I3/Ag solar cells with a power conversion efficiency up 5.3% could be fabricated at a low temperature of 250°C, which is much lower than the conventional temperature of 450°C, which is very important for the commercialization of the perovskite photovoltaics.

the ITO/CIS/Al2O3 perovskites can be prepared at a low processing temperature of only 250°C, and the performance of the solar cells can be improved by increasing the thickness of the CIS layer, which may be beneficial for large-scale fabrication of perovskite devices.
the low-temperature solution-processing technique for the fabrication of perovskite/Chalcopyrite solar cells can be extended to a variety of other chalcopyrite materials.
